profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Waymo
profile.summary: Long time TLM with deep technical expertise and strong design skills in a full-stack (backend, frontend, storage, pipelines, mobile, testing) environment.  Lately, applying these skills to make self-driving cars a reality at Waymo.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: I work on the Waymo Labeling Platform team, where we help the Waymo Driver recognize objects around the car accurately by producing high quality labeled datasets for ML engineers to improve their ML models.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
2013 - 2019:
Tech Lead / Manager of Google's Notifications Infrastructure platform for Google 1st party apps.  This platform is responsible for serving, delivering, and supporting server->mobile push notifications for over 50 major and minor Google applications.
As one of the founding members of the team, TLM and an occasional PM, guided the team to design and develop infrastructure and features useful for Google product teams and Google users.

2011 - 2013:
Tech lead of the Google+ Notifications backend team
Responsible for guiding a team to design, implement, and maintain a complicated, multi-tiered system that is scalable and extensible to handle notification storage and delivery.  Prolific and proficient coder, with a keen eye on tests, design patterns, APIs, readability, and performance.

2008 - 2011:
Individual contributor to the iGoogle and Google+ Notifications project in both frontend and backend roles.

Title / Promotions:
- Promoted to Staff Software Engineer in May 2013
- Promoted to Senior Software Engineer in Nov 2010
- Promoted to Software Engineer III in Nov 2009

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern (Part-time)
positions.description:
Rejoined iGoogle into the iGoogle Apps team as a part-time software engineer while completing the last semester of college.
Wrote server and frontend code to extended the Gmail gadget to have a canvas view with full email text and email composition capabilities.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Part of the iGoogle Frontend Engineer team.  Ate free Google food and worked hard to earn my keep.
